paragraphs: Renvizon sells public safety software that covers dispatch, records, e-ticketing, and analytics on one platform. The named products are Renvizon CAD, Renvizon RMS, Renvizon TicketWorks, and Renvizon Crash, which are described as the core systems for dispatch, records, and enforcement. A second group of products, the Renvizon AI Suite, answers policy and case data questions from a department's own documents.

Alongside the software, the company sells consulting covering procurement and RFP advisory, system integration, smart cities and NG911 readiness, data analysis, GIS services, and AI enablement. The pages name public safety agencies and law enforcement agencies as the customers, and state that the platform is CJIS compliant.

According to the about page, Renvizon is a subsidiary of 22nd Century Technologies, Inc. and unifies the capabilities of QED and Mobizent under one brand. The site says the company was formerly QED and gives its founding year as 1974.

quote.text: Unified CAD, RMS, E-Ticketing, and Analytics – AI-enabled, secure, configurable, and mission ready.
